test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the given sentence have been underlined. One of them contains an error. The underlined parts are given as options with some changes. Select the option that correctly rectifies the error.

__Raveena’s daughter__ Kavya is __most intelligent__ student and __she consistently__ achieves __top grades.__
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the omission of the article "**an**" before the term "**intelligent**."
 
• Singular countable nouns typically require an article **("a" or "an").**
 
• The correct phrase should be "**an intelligent**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Raveena’s daughter Kavya is **an intelligent** student and she consistently achieves top grades."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "Raveena’s daughter, "** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "she has consistently"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "topper grades"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
